capabilities: Search TMDB with autocomplete for movies, series, seasons, episodes and people
Insert embed cards at the cursor with poster, credits, synopsis and TMDB attribution
Insert cast cards with an actor carousel
Target specific seasons or episodes with s01e03-style search syntax
Show personal viewing statistics on person cards from an exported Track 'n' Review profile
disambiguation: Not a movie tracker itself; it only inserts TMDB cards and reads statistics from the separate Track 'n' Review iPhone app.
extras: README is written in Portuguese; the plugin interface and TMDB data are localized for pt-BR and en-US. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or higher.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up film or TV metadata and insert rich cards for it, so users must compile that information by hand.
